How to set up Consul on Kubernetes using Helm
output: helm install consul hashicorp/consul --set global.name=consul --set server.replicas=3

instruction: How to install Consul on Kubernetes
output: helm repo add hashicorp https://helm.releases.hashicorp.com && helm install consul hashicorp/consul --create-namespace --namespace consul

instruction: How to install Consul with Connect enabled on Kubernetes
output: helm install consul hashicorp/consul --set connectInject.enabled=true --set client.enabled=true

instruction: How to install Consul with ingress gateway on Kubernetes
output: helm install consul hashicorp/consul --set connectInject.enabled=true --set ingressGateways.enabled=true --set ingressGateways.gateways[0].name=ingress-gateway

How to set up Consul service defaults on Kubernetes
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceDefaults
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  protocol: http'

instruction: How to create a Consul ServiceIntentions on Kubernetes
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceIntentions
metadata:
  name: web-api
spec:
  sources:
  - name: web
    action: allow
  destination:
    name: api'

instruction: How to create a Consul ServiceRouter on Kubernetes
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceRouter
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  routes:
  - match:
      http:
        pathPrefix: /v1
    destination:
      service: web-v1
  - match:
      http:
        pathPrefix: /v2
    destination:
      service: web-v2'
